author: Disney
description:
Just when Jack begins to think he’s too old for Christmas, he befriends an invisible creature that reminds him of what makes Christmas so magical. Directed by Dougal Wilson, A Disney Holiday Short: The Invisible Horse follows Jack and his unlikely companion on a journey to rediscover the magic of the holidays.

This holiday season, Disney is bringing families together through timeless stories, cherished traditions, and unforgettable experiences that Make the Holidays Magic. Join us and help make the holidays magic for kids and families when it’s needed most. Learn more at Disney.com/HolidayMagic.
